conventions.missing: Empty CSV cell. Missing categories propagate to all corresponding indicators. Source refusal, unknown, skip and noninterview codes are handled by field-specific rules.
conventions.source_dates: NLSY79 source-year columns are survey years or aggregate observation bounds. Follow-up uses actual interview ending months.
conventions.binary: Numeric 0/1, or True/False in intermediate eligibility fields.
conventions.weights: Provider cross-sectional weights and repeated-pair balancing weights have separate meanings.
conventions.units: Age and durations in years, height in meters, weight in kilograms, BMI in kg/m^2. Monetary real values use CPI-U 2020 dollars.
conventions.source_context: Row-level source tables include both observed and provider-imputed cognition. Analysis variants are identified by table name.
conventions.model_inputs: Use explicit feature lists. Table membership alone does not imply predictor status.
conventions.education_timing: RAND RAEDYRS uses first available education across waves with Tracker fallback. Its exact source wave is unavailable per person in this export. Use the prespecified education-excluded sensitivity when strict temporal availability cannot be established.

conventions.missing: Empty CSV cell. Missing categories propagate to all corresponding indicators. Source refusal, unknown, skip and noninterview codes are handled by field-specific rules.
conventions.source_dates: NLSY79 source-year columns are survey years or aggregate observation bounds. Follow-up uses actual interview ending months.
conventions.binary: Numeric 0/1, or True/False in intermediate eligibility fields.
conventions.weights: Provider cross-sectional weights and repeated-pair balancing weights have separate meanings.
conventions.units: Age and durations in years, height in meters, weight in kilograms, BMI in kg/m^2. Monetary real values use CPI-U 2020 dollars.
conventions.source_context: Row-level source tables include both observed and provider-imputed cognition. Analysis variants are identified by table name.
conventions.model_inputs: Use explicit feature lists. Table membership alone does not imply predictor status.
conventions.education_timing: RAND RAEDYRS uses first available education across waves with Tracker fallback. Its exact source wave is unavailable per person in this export. Use the prespecified education-excluded sensitivity when strict temporal availability cannot be established.
